title: Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions
tagline: Four Spider-Men, four worlds, one broken tablet.
summary: Beenox splits the player across four Spider-Men: a present-day Peter, Spider-Man Noir, Miguel O’Hara, and an Ultimate-universe Peter. The Ultimate Peter in this game is not Miles Morales. The levels are separate dimensions, not the animated films.
gameplay: Linear levels that change combat rules with each Spider-Man. Noir emphasizes stealth. The 2099 levels use accelerated movement.
